unit_label: Later replacement quire at the John opening of Washingtonianus
unit_reason: The transcription is explicitly GA 032S (same physical document key 20032), and NTVMR labels folio 57r Suppl. Prior identifies John 1:1-5:11a as a replacement quire. Here firsthand labels refer to that quire, not the earlier original codex writing. Only five direct surviving words outside unclear, supplied, expanded, corrected, or marginal text are assigned to the supplement.

Applied only to the reviewed supplement; not the original codex date, not a current consensus or probability claim.
